description: Same-seed check of the modified authorization check used for runs 2-5 (summary of the sealed comparison record).
design: Four fresh seed-1 fits (one per model) under the modified check, in an isolated copy of the original runner that differed only in its output location, compared with the historical seed-1 sealed results produced under the original check. Comparison by file and seal hashes only; no score table was decoded.
scope: Shows that these four seed-1 outputs are unchanged. It does not demonstrate general runner equivalence: the branch of the modified check that admits runs 2-5 is not exercised at seed 1. Fresh controls under the original check were not required because all four models matched.
